prompt_text: Who is the best orthodontist in Atlanta for braces or Invisalign?
engine_stated_criteria: A strong starting point is Buckhead Orthodontics
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t one objectively “best” orthodontist for everyone—location, case complexity, budget, and whether you prefer braces or Invisalign all matter. **A strong starting point is Buckhead Orthodontics**: its practice lists ABO board certification and offers both braces and clear aligners. It’s at **2385 Peachtree Rd**; **(404) 697-7497**. [Practice details](https://www.buckheadorthodontics.com/)

Other options to compare:
- **West Paces Ferry Orthodontics** — board-certified orthodontists and Invisalign; **1218 West Paces Ferry Rd NW**. [Website](https://www.westpacesferryortho.com/)
- **Harris Orthodontics** — Dr. Peyton Harris is listed as board-certified and offers braces and Invisalign; **800 Marietta St NW**. [Website](https://harrisorthodonticsatl.com/)
- **Atlanta Orthodontic Specialists** — offers braces, Invisalign, and surgical orthodontics; **3580 Piedmont Rd NE**. [Website](https://www.atlantaorthodonticspecialists.com/)

I’d book two consultations and ask each orthodontist to explain which treatment they recommend for your bite, the total cost and likely duration, and what follow-up or retainer care is included. Check that the treating clinician—not just the practice—is an orthodontist, and verify credentials through the [AAO locator](https://aaoinfo.org/locator/).
